verification: Capacity (simulated, 2 CPU / 4 GB): 1,700 sessions held, ramp 98% at 300 a minute, 3.5-6.6 s per sign-in when idle; the sustained-churn target of 300 sign-ins a minute is NOT MET (19 of 3,000). Failure behaviour: netd and PostgreSQL restarts recover in seconds; a four-minute acctd outage takes guests offline after 90 s and reconciles raw = minute = hour afterwards. Offline first activation on a factory-clean appliance against an isolated Central: activation, assignment, licence binding, single use, tampered and truncated packages refused. Not performed: physical devices at scale, reference hardware, real PMS post-stay traffic, a Central-disconnect test in the lab.
